description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component, verifying its behavior regarding onboarding flow presentation and state persistence.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore functionality, including presentation logic and state persistence.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding should present when the app is fresh and disconnected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Test that onboarding should not present when the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Test that marking onboarding as complete persists the mode and updates presentation state accordingly.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Test that the first run intro is initially visible and then marked as seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Test that resetting the onboarding state clears completion and intro seen flags, and restores initial presentation behavior.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates test-specific UserDefaults instance with a unique suite name.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the UserDefaults for the test suite, clearing all stored state.
